notes.title: Here is the latest update of Land of Zombies
notes.content:
Based on user reviews, we have modified many things about this game on this update. 
* Better Physics.
* Headshot setup with extra rewards.
* Replaced "Ultra Kill, Mega Kill, Kill Confirmed" audios with zombie hurt audios.
* Set up Head Shot sound effect for better understanding on if the player made a headshot or not. 
* M4a1 Gunfire sound replaced with a better one.
* Now Some Zombies have more speed and more health.
